asOfNote: Every field below is copied from contracts/config/deployments/robinhood-mainnet.json, which records values read back from the deployed contracts' own getters with `cast call`. This file restates that record; it is not an independent reading, and it is not refreshed by anything. `generatedFrom` names the commit it was copied at so a reader can diff the two.
chainNote: The DATA is Robinhood Chain mainnet. PAYMENT for this route settles in USDC on Base mainnet. The two chains are independent on purpose: x402 metering is an API concern and touches no contract on either chain.
notIncluded: Balances, NAV, share supply and member positions are NOT in this snapshot. They move block to block, and a pinned file that carried them would be wrong within minutes of being written while still looking authoritative. The fields above are creation-time facts, which do not move. Serving live balances is a chain read at request time and is the next step for this route, not something this file can honestly fake.
